subject: re-doc
title: (R)RE.DOC.------C.CONT.
description: First of two diagrams in CMOA(II)-53 facing Braxton's account of the 'suppression cycle' — 'this is the period where one asks the question "whatever happened to ole Joe?" From a dynamic beginning, where a given thrust alignment served as basis for both new projectional forms and vitality, and in doing so provided the vibrational uplift for composite world culture, to a suppressed scattering of surprised musicians (who probably are still fighting each other) — this is what I mean by trans-response-shift pattern.' The crossing diagrams the structural condition under which that pattern becomes possible: (R)RE-DOC (the *reality* of redocumentation — the cycle in which a thrust alignment gets historicized) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance — whether the form's actual vibrational thrust keeps moving). RE-DOC sits in the lower-left with the subject-arrow; PART (the reality of participation) hangs immediately above it, the load-bearing condition for redocumentation to remain alive. AF-NT (affinity natural) anchors the bottom-center as the bottom output. On the partner side, C-CONT is the central hub: it routes to SPT-DYM (spirit-dynamic) up-right, AFTF (after-the-fact) directly right, and INFO-F (information form) down-right, with CRTF-PROG (creative-progression) hanging off INFO-F at the far lower-right. Across the top, SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) feeds into TRS (transformation) and TRS fans out to ALT-F (alternative form) and back down into C-CONT. Structural argument: when redocumentation is crossed with composite-continuance, the diagonals running from the upper-left (SOC-RT-DY/TRS) through C-CONT and down to CRTF-PROG show the *only* viable path — redocumentation becomes continuance only when transformation actively routes social-reality-dynamics through composite-continuance into creative-progression. Lose the diagonal — let TRS terminate at ALT-F instead — and the partner-axis stops reaching across; redocumentation gets stranded with PART alone holding it up, and the trans-response-shift pattern follows.
